response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS behavior_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON a.translink COLLATE BINARY = tr.transreg COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref COLLATE BINARY = t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT trader_type, behavior_count, 1.0 * behavior_count / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS share FROM per_type), compared AS (SELECT trader_type, behavior_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT trader_type, behavior_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM compared WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL AND share > average_share ORDER BY share DESC, trader_type;
